directLaw.rule: Whole reduction for qualifying loss coverage under the no-creditor-notice route takes effect upon registration. The dividend decision is restricted for three years from that registration unless a stated exception has been fulfilled.
Share capital again increased by at least the reduction amount is an express exception. This text does not supply a multi-reduction allocation algorithm.
Following the applicable creditor procedure is an express exception. Publication, notice period, resolved objections and registered completion cannot be replaced with elapsed six weeks alone.
A period in years ends on the corresponding calendar date; if absent in that month, the final day of that month.
The next-working-day extension is expressly worded for a handlingsfrist.
Separate simultaneous notification route requires new shares against contributions and restoration of restricted equity. Do not silently map this to every later nominal increase.

engineeringMapping.basis: Implementation inferences and supported-domain choices, not additional statutory rules.
engineeringMapping.ownedBy: Corporate Governance owns reduction history, clearance evidence and the as-of dividend-decision result. Documents owns originals; application composes public evidence; RF consumes immutable results and binds them into source/approval.
requiredRecord: clearance kind, effective date/order, evidence and linked reduction(s)
engineeringMapping.dateRule: calendarEnd = add three calendar years(registrationDate), clamping a missing final-month day. Use authoritative Norwegian civil dates; no 1095-day duration, income-year reset, browser time zone or UTC-derived date.
engineeringMapping.decisionRule: Evaluate the legal dividend decision date. A later payment, filing, elapsed time at approval read, or later clearance cannot retrospectively cure a decision made while restricted.

supportedTimeStates.beforeRegistration: This reduction has not yet taken effect; other reductions and all ordinary dividend guards still apply. Same-date ordering needs evidence.
supportedTimeStates.beforeCalendarEnd: restricted unless an independently verified exception was already effective before the decision.
supportedTimeStates.boundaryInterval: unknown for a decision on calendarEnd. Where calendarEnd is non-working, retain unknown through any potentially applicable next working day until waiting-period applicability is settled. This is a bounded support limitation, not an assertion that the law adds a day or shifts this waiting period.
supportedTimeStates.safelyAfterBoundary: elapsed for this restriction only, with complete relevant history; this does not certify distributable equity, solvency, liquidity or other decision requirements.

earlyClearance.initialRestorationCase: One unambiguously linked qualifying reduction and ordinary cash capital increase, no intervening unresolved reductions, legally effective registered increase at least equal to reduction, proved before the dividend decision. Premium or a bank deposit is not registered share capital. A dated same-day registration/decision without order remains unknown.
earlyClearance.creditorCase: Require evidence that the applicable §12-6 route was completed and legally effective before the decision, including registration; no automated legal determination of a disputed creditor claim.
earlyClearance.unknownException: Do not accept a caller's cleared flag, assign one increase to several reductions, invent FIFO/netting, or count unsupported noncash/fund/simultaneous events as established clearance.

engineeringMapping.multipleReductions: Evaluate every applicable reduction independently. A new event neither resets nor removes old history. Return a set of restriction/evidence results; any unresolved applicable restriction prevents this gate being clear. Independently elapsed reductions need no speculative capital-restoration allocation.
engineeringMapping.absenceRule: An empty current reporting year is not absence of prior reductions. Carry verified opening history/completeness, retain corrections, and require relevant event enumeration before a clear result. Do not turn historical dividend restrictions into an unsupported ban on recording capital events.
engineeringMapping.approvalBinding: Bind actual decision date, complete evidence revision/hash, all applicable reductions and clearance bases. Recheck at approval/dispatch; changed history invalidates dependent admission while preserving original records.
